title: strandline: a dependency-light Rust engine for satellite-derived shoreline extraction and change analysis
description: Compiled engine that ports the CoastSat satellite-derived-shoreline method (water index, pixel classification, class-balanced Otsu threshold and sub-pixel marching-squares contour) into a single Rust binary, and extends it with native harmonic tidal synthesis, vectorised transect intersection and DSAS-style change rates with quality control. Each stage is validated against its reference (CoastSat, pyTMD, and the stored per-transect tables of a national erosion study). This archive contains the source, the test suite and the benchmark artefacts for six sites along the coast of Chile. Satellite scenes are not redistributed: they are public Landsat and Sentinel-2 products, retrievable with the included 'fetch' subcommand.
